name: Clobazam
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: CYP3A4, with smaller CYP2C19/CYP2B6 contributions, forms active N-desmethylclobazam. This metabolite is cleared mainly by CYP2C19. Elimination is mostly urinary as metabolites.
